{{Quote|You need to come out to Rishi, man. Camrov, Mochiri and me, we're getting to make a real difference out here, like the stuff we used to talk about.|Orton's message to Kelvi|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic: Shadow of Revan">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Shadow of Revan]]''</ref>}}
'''Kelvi''' was a [[Soldier/Legends|soldier]] in the [[Republic Military/Legends|Republic Military]] during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. Kelvi was friends with [[Orton]], who nicknamed Kelvi "Blaster Breath," and Orton tried to convince Kelvi to join the [[Order of Revan]].
